app.title: KageLeak
app.description: Data breaches affect millions of people. KageLeak allows you to check if your email address has been compromised in seconds. Stay safe, stay aware.

about.title: About Me
about.description: Hello! I'm Kage, a passionate professional in cybersecurity and software development. The KageLeak project is an initiative I developed to raise awareness about email security and protect users.

mission.title: My Mission
mission.description: I work to enhance the digital security of internet users and raise awareness against data breaches.

vision.title: My Vision
vision.description: To provide innovative solutions for creating a secure environment in the digital world and raising user awareness.
